user_goal: Correct the owned-listener false rejection discovered during the authorized v0.1.9 install and publish a verified patch.

baseline.protection_evidence: origin/main and immutable v0.1.9 release resolve to the exact reviewed commit
baseline.selection_reason: The v0.1.9 install exposed locale-dependent comparison of the same process creation instant.

semantic_changes: Canonicalize process creation instants across locale representations before ownership comparison.
Write new owner records with an invariant timestamp representation while accepting truthful legacy records.
Preserve fail-closed rejection of malformed, stale, PID-reused, or foreign listener records.
No ownership inference from HTML or argv substrings, ledger mutation, unrelated behavior change, foreign listener takeover, secret exposure, tag rewrite, or unreviewed release.

invariants: Only an owner record whose PID, port, root, connector, executable, creation instant, and command hash match may authorize stop or reuse.
Equivalent timestamp representations compare as the same instant; invalid timestamps fail closed.
A real foreign spoof listener survives unchanged.
PR, CodeRabbit, CI, signed receipts, public main, tag, installed package, and live service bind one exact candidate.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: Equivalent 12-hour, 24-hour, and invariant owner creation timestamps match the same live process instant.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: String-format mismatch rejects a truthful owned listener or malformed timestamp passes.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: Foreign, stale, malformed, and PID-reused records remain rejected without stopping the listener.
PR review and exact-head CI are green.
Signed receipts, verifier, and guard approve exact v0.1.10.
Owned v0.1.9 listener upgrades to exact healthy v0.1.10 with a clean checkout.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: Manual ownership bypass, dirty install, or unhealthy service.

proof_requirements.claim: Executable tests prove locale-independent creation-instant identity and invariant new records.
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: focused lifecycle tests and real owned upgrade
proof_requirements.expected_observation: same instant accepted; malformed instant denied

proof_requirements.claim: Existing and new adversarial listener tests remain fail-closed.
Raw review and exact-head checks are green.
proof_requirements.expected_observation: zero unresolved findings and all checks success

proof_requirements.claim: Independent signed chain is accepted by verifier and guard.
Public and installed artifacts are exact, healthy, and clean.
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: Actions, tag, package, owner, connector, health, git status

release_requirements.required_receipt: signed chain accepted by verifier and guard

stop_conditions: Unexpected diff, weakened ownership fields, foreign listener termination, dirty or multiple worktrees, failed test/CI/review, non-PASS receipt, verifier/guard rejection, or live failure.
known_discrepancies: v0.1.9 package files installed successfully, but its restart failed closed because equivalent locale-formatted process creation timestamps compared as unequal strings; the existing v0.1.8 process remains healthy.

requirement_trace.authority: User continuation through a working reviewed release
